legal_codes.0: Clear of restriction zones; OK for A3 distances
legal_codes.1: Flight Restriction Zone: no flying without permission from the airport/prison
legal_codes.10: Within 150 m of housing (A3 no-go; fine for a sub-250 g whoop)
legal_codes.11: Within 150 m of commercial/industrial land, a school or a hospital (A3 no-go)
legal_codes.12: Within 150 m of a park or recreational area (A3 no-go)
legal_codes.13: Within 50 m of a building (A3 no-go)
legal_codes.14: Within 50 m of a busy road (A3 no-go)

flag_bits.1: National Trust land: they ban drone take-off without a permit
flag_bits.4: Nature reserve or SSSI: byelaws often ban drones; watch for nesting birds
flag_bits.8: Forestry England land: needs their permission for drones
flag_bits.16: Woodland Trust land: drones need permission
flag_bits.32: Cemetery or churchyard: not a place to fly
flag_bits.64: Golf course: private land, and flying golf balls
flag_bits.128: Railway within 30 m: stay well clear of the line
flag_bits.512: Inside a danger area: only fly when it's not active (check NOTAMs)
flag_bits.1024: Busy pedestrian area: never fly over crowds
flag_bits.2048: Quarry: private site with workers and vehicles; needs the operator's OK
flag_bits.4096: Common land / town moor: public open space, so it counts as a recreational area for A3
flag_bits.8192: English Heritage site: no taking off or landing there, and they ask you not to fly over it

seeds.name: Nuns Moor Park trees by Cow Hill
seeds.note: Weaving in and around the tree clumps on the Town Moor edge, near Hunters Moor Hospital. The moor counts as a recreational area, so it isn't A3-clear for an 800 g quad.

seeds.name: Nine Arches viaduct and the river beach, Derwent Walk
seeds.note: Arches to fly through ~25 m over the Derwent, a gravel beach underneath to take off from, woods either side. Two big power lines cross by its west end, so stay low under them.

seeds.name: Newcastle Helix: Urban Sciences Building and Frederick Douglass Centre
seeds.note: Whoop lines around modern buildings, plazas and gaps at Newcastle Helix.
flags: Busy pedestrian area: never fly over crowds
